text:
The naval officer who turns up in every one of Pepys’s December diary entries – with the single exception of December 1668 – is **Sir William Penn** (often written as “Sir W. Penn”).

Pepys’s diaries frequently reference Penn’s dealings with Admiralty accounts, his visits to the naval offices, and his general influence at the Admiralty. In the December 1668 entry, however, the narrative notes that “Sir W. Penn is removed from his position,” marking the only December in which he is not mentioned. All other Decembers (1660 – 1667, 1669) contain references to him. Thus, Sir William Penn is the figure the question is looking for.
